title: AU Asset Finance
description:
Asset Finance Support

Remote / Work from Home |AEST Hours | Supporting Australian Asset Finance Brokers



Who We're Looking For

We're building a dedicated team of asset finance support professionals to work directly with Australian asset finance brokers. If you have hands-on experience processing equipment, vehicle, or commercial asset finance applications and understand the end-to-end broker workflow, we want to hear from you.



To Apply, please submit this form: forms.cloud.microsoft/r/4t0GcvqYPy



What You'll Be Doing Every Day



Managing asset finance files end-to-end — from initial client enquiry through to settlement and post-settlement

Data entry and file management in broker CRM platforms (Mercury, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Preparing and submitting finance applications to lenders via broker portals

Ordering and tracking asset valuations and credit assessments

Requesting and tracking pricing and rate concessions from lenders

Running asset finance calculators — balloon payments, residual values, comparison rates, repayment schedules

Preparing compliance documents, credit diary notes, settlement letters, and payout figures

Ordering and interpreting commercial credit reports (e.g. Equifax, CreditorWatch, Veda)

Coordinating with lenders, vendors, dealers, and clients throughout the approval and settlement process

Managing discharge and payout requests, PPSR checks, and ASIC searches

Preparing funds-to-complete confirmations and settlement instructions

Post-settlement tasks — invoice reconciliation, asset registration follow-up, client retention





You Must Have

2–3 years of experience in Australian asset finance — broker-side, not lender operations

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

 Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Excellent written and spoken English — direct communication with brokers, clients, and lenders



Minimum Requirements



Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have



Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Exposure to construction equipment, yellow goods, or specialised asset classes

Familiarity with commercial property-backed asset finance

Experience using ApplyOnline, Loanapp, or Simpology for commercial submissions

Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking or equivalent





Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer



Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

title: HR Operations & Systems Coordinator

Key Focus Areas

* Organising workforce records, contracts, and employment documentation

* Creating practical templates, checklists, and process documentation

* Helping improve visibility, structure, follow-through, and operational consistency across the HR function

* Strong process and systems mindset

* Excellent organisation and follow-through

* Experience supporting remote teams

* Strong English communication skills

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving operational environment

* Experience supporting manufacturing, FMCG, logistics, production, or other operational workforce environments would be highly beneficial, particularly in understanding the pace, structure, and practical realities of the workforce being supported.

* Experience supporting growing or evolving businesses where systems and processes are still being built and refined would be highly regarded



Ideal Person



We are looking for someone who is:



* Practical and operationally minded

* Highly organised and detail-oriented

* Responsive with strong follow-through

* Comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity

* Confident improving systems and workflows

* Able to work independently while coordinating remotely with teams

Engagement Structure

title: Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator
description:
Who is Bare?

Bare is the new way to funeral. We are a holistic end of life care provider, allowing our families to grieve in their own way, at their own pace, knowing their loved one is cared for by a team who truly understand their needs.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalized and affordable. In only five years, we’ve served more than 30,000 families, have become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (with awards in customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and have built a team of more than 100 people committed to changing the way Australians deal with end-of-life. And we’re just getting started.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator to manage operations for our Australian business. This multi-faceted role is critical to maintaining seamless daily logistics. You will be responsible for orchestrating domestic and corporate travel, managing supplier procurement in line with local compliance, and assisting with the maintenance and safety of our corporate fleet.

The ideal candidate understands the Australian vendor landscape, has experience managing corporate travel across ANZ, and brings a strong customer-service focus to supporting our local workforce.



Key Responsibilities

1. Travel Management (Approx. 40%)

Booking & Domestic Logistics: Coordinate extensive corporate travel bookings across Australia (interstate) including flights (Qantas, Virgin Australia, Jetstar), corporate accommodation, and car rentals.

Policy Compliance: Enforce the company’s travel and expense policy, ensuring cost-efficient booking habits and appropriate tier selections.



TMC & Platform Management: Act as the primary administrator for the corporate travel management platform (e.g., Corporate Traveller, FCM, or Serko) and handle corporate profile updates.



Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) & Expense Alignment: Support the Finance team by ensuring travel expenses are accurately categorized to assist with FBT reporting and tracking meals/entertainment allowances.



2. Procurement & Supplier Relations (Approx. 40%)

Local Sourcing: Raise purchase requisitions and manage the end-to-end purchase order (PO) process for Australian suppliers, covering office supplies, IT equipment, and operational materials.



Vendor Management: Onboard new vendors, track supplier performance, and maintain compliant records including valid Australian Business Numbers (ABNs) and GST status verification.



Payment Lifecycle Collaboration: Reconcile invoices against delivery receipts and POs, liaising closely with the Accounts Payable team to ensure adherence to agreed payment terms.



Modern Slavery Act Compliance: Assist the procurement team in verifying supplier compliance in alignment with corporate social responsibility guidelines and local Modern Slavery reporting frameworks.



3. Fleet Management Assistance (Approx. 20%)

Asset Tracking & Registration: Maintain an updated corporate fleet registry, ensuring all vehicle registrations (via relevant state bodies like VicRoads, Transport for NSW, TMR, etc.) and compulsory third-party (CTP) insurances are systematically renewed.



Maintenance & Safety: Coordinate scheduled logbook servicing, tyre replacements, and vehicle inspections to maintain fleet safety and uphold manufacturer warranties.



Fuel Cards & Linkt/E-Toll Management: Monitor corporate fuel card accounts (e.g., Ampol, BP, Shell) and toll account usage (e.g., Linkt), reporting on weekly or monthly variances.



I
 Management: Assist drivers with a
 reporting processes, insurance claims documentation, and coordinating roadside assistance when required.



Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an operations, procurement, or corporate travel coordination role within Australia. Previous exposure to vehicle fleet coordination or logistics is highly regarded.



Technical Systems: Proficiency with ERP/financial software (e.g., Xero, MYOB, SAP, NetSuite), expense management tools, and corporate travel software (e.g., Velocity, Concur).



Regulatory Understanding: Familiarity with Australian business operational requirements, including GST invoicing principles, state-based vehicle registration rules, and basic workplace safety requirements.



Communication & Negotiation: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to handling internal staff requests and local vendor negotiations.



Problem-Solving: Strong situational awareness with the ability to resolve rapid shifts in logistics, such as travel disruptions or freight delays.



What We Offer

Competitive salary package.

Collaborative team environment with hybrid working flexibility.

Clear pathways for professional growth and career progression across the operations and procurement functions.



Please include a link to your resume for review.

title: Operations Procurement Coordinator
description:
Operations Procurement Coordinator (Remote)



We are a growing international food manufacturing business with operations across Vanuatu and Australia, currently focused on strengthening procurement coordination, operational support systems, supplier management, and supply chain visibility during a period of growth and operational scale-up.



We are looking for a highly organised and operationally minded Procurement Coordinator to help support the day-to-day purchasing and operational supply requirements of our Vanuatu manufacturing operation remotely.



This is a hands-on operational coordination role focused on keeping things moving, supporting operational continuity, improving follow-through, and helping build more consistent and scalable procurement systems and workflows across the business.



The role is heavily focused on supplier coordination, freight and shipping follow-up, purchasing support, workflow visibility, operational prioritisation, and practical day-to-day execution rather than purely strategic or corporate procurement activity.



Key Focus Areas



* Coordinating operational purchasing requirements across packaging, consumables, spare parts, PPE, services, and general operational supplies

* Managing supplier communication, follow-up, and order coordination

* Supporting freight, shipping, import/export, and logistics coordination for Vanuatu operations

* Tracking ETAs, supply risks, urgent operational requirements, and critical stock items

* Supporting operational continuity through proactive communication and follow-through

* Coordinating closely with operations, warehouse/logistics, finance, production, and suppliers across multiple locations and time zones

* Assisting with procurement records, documentation, PO tracking, spend visibility, and traceability requirements

* Supporting procurement workflow consistency, process improvement, and practical systems development within a growing SME/startup environment

* Providing timely updates, escalating issues early, and helping maintain visibility across operational purchasing activities



 Ideal Experience



* Procurement, purchasing, supply coordination, logistics, or operational support experience

* Previous experience supporting manufacturing, FMCG, food production, industrial operations, logistics, or other operationally intensive environments is considered essential due to the pace, operational coordination requirements, and manufacturing continuity responsibilities involved

* Experience coordinating suppliers, freight providers, and operational purchasing activities

* Experience coordinating packaging, consumables, spare parts, PPE, maintenance-related items, and operational services highly regarded

* Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple moving priorities

* Strong communication and follow-through

* Comfortable working remotely with operational teams across locations and time zones

* Experience using procurement, ERP, inventory, or operational systems (Netsuite, SAP, Batchmaster, MYOB, etc.) advantageous

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets capability preferred

* Comfortable working within evolving systems and fast-paced operational environments



### Ideal Person



We are looking for someone who is:



* Practical and operationally focused

* Highly organised and responsive

* Strong with follow-through and communication

* Comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity

* Able to balance urgency, operational continuity, and cost awareness

* Calm under pressure and solutions-focused

* Comfortable working independently while supporting a fast-moving operational team remotely



 Additional Notes



This role supports a Vanuatu-based manufacturing operation remotely and requires strong coordination, communication, responsiveness, and operational prioritisation across suppliers, freight providers, and internal teams.



The role requires regular daily coordination with Australian suppliers, freight providers, and the Vanuatu operations team. Candidates must therefore be comfortable communicating via phone,
, and video calls and working primarily within Australian and Vanuatu business hours.



We are ideally looking for someone available to commence within the next 1–2 weeks, as our current Procurement Officer finishes on June 12 and we are focused on maintaining operational continuity during the transition.



We are open to:



* Full-time or part-time arrangements

* Project-based or ongoing support

* Remote engagement

* Potential future growth depending on business needs and long-term structure



Compensation



USD $12–15/hour depending on experience, manufacturing/procurement background, and overall capability.

title: Senior Shopify Technical SEO Specialist (Canonical, Crawl Budget & Indexation Cleanup)
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced Shopify Technical SEO Specialist to help analyze and resolve critical technical SEO and indexation issues for a large ecommerce store.



IMPORTANT:

This is NOT a basic SEO/content role. We are specifically looking for someone with REAL hands-on experience in advanced Shopify technical SEO, ecommerce crawl/indexation optimization, and large-scale duplicate URL management.



Required Experience & Skills:



* Shopify Technical SEO

* Ecommerce SEO

* Canonical optimization

* Crawl budget optimization

* Google Search Console coverage/indexation analysis

* Faceted navigation handling

* Duplicate content cleanup

* Shopify collection/filter/tag URL structures

* Technical SEO audits

* Crawlability & indexability optimization

* Redirect and 404 management

* Shopify SEO architecture



Current issues include:



* Large amount of duplicate URLs generated by collection filters, sorting parameters, and tag-based URLs

* Missing/inconsistent canonical handling

* High amount of “Crawled – currently not indexed” pages

* Large number of non-indexed URLs

* 404 and redirect issues

* Crawl inefficiencies and possible crawl budget waste

* 429 crawl errors during SEO crawls

* Significant drop in indexed pages over recent months

* General Shopify indexation instability



We are looking for someone who can:



* Perform a detailed technical SEO audit

* Identify the root causes of crawl/indexation issues

* Recommend practical and scalable solutions

* Improve crawl efficiency and index quality

* Help clean up duplicate URL/indexation problems

* Optimize Shopify canonical handling

* Provide implementation guidance or assist implementation directly



Preferred Experience:



* Large Shopify or Shopify Plus stores

* Enterprise ecommerce SEO

* Faceted navigation SEO handling

* Crawl budget optimization

* Advanced Google Search Console debugging

* Technical SEO for stores with large product/catalog structures



Tools/Platforms Experience:



* Google Search Console

* Screaming Frog

* Sitebulb

* Ahrefs / Semrush

* Shopify admin & Shopify URL structures



IMPORTANT:

Please only apply if you have REAL experience with advanced Shopify technical SEO and ecommerce indexation cleanup.



When applying, please include:



1. Examples of similar Shopify technical SEO projects you handled

2. Your experience with crawl budget/indexation optimization

3. Tools you typically use

4. Your approach to Shopify duplicate URL/canonical problems

5. Examples of measurable SEO improvements/results you achieved



Strong communication and technical explanation skills are highly valued.



To help us identify detail-oriented applicants, please begin your application with the word “Onyx” and briefly mention your experience with Shopify canonical or indexation issues.

- Collaborate with clients to structure loans, balancing fixed or variable rates and flexible loan terms.

- Guide clients through mortgage applications and ensure timely collection of essential documentation (pay slips, tax returns, bank statements, credit reports).

- Submit complete application packages to underwriters, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

- Securely handle documents using platforms like DocuSign and Ezidox.



4. Credit Analysis & Compliance

- Analyze credit reports, suggest improvement strategies, and address potential credit barriers.

- Ensure full compliance with Australian mortgage regulations, including the Loan Estimate and Closing Disclosure.



5. Communication & Coordination

- Maintain clear, timely, and professional communication with clients, brokers, lenders, real estate agents, and underwriters.

- Provide updates on loan status and proactively resolve client inquiries and concerns.



6. Negotiation & Rate Lock Assistance

- Assist in negotiating loan terms and conditions.

- Guide clients through the interest rate lock process to secure competitive rates.



7. Post-Closing Support & Follow-up

- Ensure smooth loan settlement by coordinating the preparation of final documents.

- Support clients post-settlement with direct debit arrangements, offset accounts, and other follow-up services.



8. Networking & Lead Generation (if applicable)

- Build and nurture relationships with key referral partners (e.g., real estate agents, financial planners, accountants).

- Leverage LinkedIn, industry groups, and freelancer platforms for lead generation.



9. Continuous Learning & System Optimization

- Stay updated on evolving lender policies, industry trends, and technology tools.

- Collaborate on initiatives to streamline client onboarding and loan processing workflows.



Qualifications

1. End-to-end experience in the Australian Mortgage industry.

2. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for financial assessments and reporting.

3. In-depth knowledge of mortgage compliance, industry guidelines, and lender procedures.

4. Proficient in Salesforce, Creatio, Salestrekker, ApplyOnline, Mercury, and Equifax.

5. Experience using digital platforms such as Equifax and IDyou for client verification and credit analysis.

6. Proven ability to manage multiple applications and maintain accuracy under pressure.

7. Experience working with Australian aggregators (AFG, Connective, SFG) is a plus.

8. Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics and the Microsoft 365 Suite, or equivalent platforms.

9. Strong written and verbal communication abilities.

10. Capable of handling confidential information with integrity and discretion.

11. Prior experience in client service or administrative roles is advantageous.

12. Proactive approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to take initiative.

13. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

14. Adaptable to fast-paced environments and able to manage multiple priorities.

15. Knowledge or background in property management and trust accounting is a plus, though not mandatory.

16. A positive attitude towards continuous learning and professional development, especially in property management systems like PropertyMe or similar software.

JOB TITLE: Executive Assistant — Medical Practice (Remote)

ABOUT THE PRACTICE



Valley Heart and Rhyth
dical is a new solo specialty practice in the Los Angeles area, founded and led by a cardiac electrophysiologist (heart rhythm specialist) launching after thirteen years with a large group practice. The practice opens in late summer 2026 and is being built deliberately as a small, high-quality team focused on specialty cardiac care.



This Executive Assistant role is the operational backbone of the practice. The person in this role will manage the physician's inbox, calendar, and project follow-through; document how things work; and steadily build the systems that allow a small team to run a high-quality specialty practice. This is a long-term role, and the practice is hiring for a multi-year partnership.



RESPONSIBILITIES



In the first ninety days:

• Manage the physician's inbox, calendar, and project follow-through. Take ownership of work that does not require the physician's judgment.

• Shadow the on-shore operations manager and document her workflows into clear, written standard operating procedures.

• Identify repetitive administrative tasks (claims follow-up, prior authorizations, scheduling logistics, intake coordination, document handling) that can be taken off the on-shore team's plate as the EA ramps up.

• Build a foundational documentation set — contact directories, vendor lists, payer information, credential records (handled securely).

• Establish working rhythms — standing check-ins, communication channels, project tracking.

• Help evaluate and select the operational tools (project management, secure file sharing, password management) the practice has not yet finalized.



Ongoing:

• Run the day-to-day administrative operations of the practice.

• Continuously refine SOPs as the practice learns from operating them.

• Coordinate with vendors, payers, hospital affiliations, and credentialing partners.

• Surface operational issues early, with proposed solutions where appropriate.

• Mentor and support additional offshore administrative tea
mbers as the team grows over time. The executive assistant work for the physician remains the core of this role.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



This role calls for someone who has worked inside a US medical practice before — ideally a specialty practice such as cardiology, internal medicine, electrophysiology, psychiatric, or similar — and who understands how a clinic operates on the inside: scheduling, prior authorizations, EHR workflows, payer dynamics, and patient communication.



The ideal candidate thinks in systems, writes clearly, and takes ownership without needing to be directed step by step. Documentation skill matters: SOPs, patient communications, payer letters, and vendor coordination are written work, and the quality of the writing is the quality of the work.



This is a remote role with significant autonomy. The right person makes sensible decisions independently, escalates clearly when needed, and brings forward well-framed problems with proposed solutions.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Three or more years experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Medical Administrative Assistant

• Two or more years working inside a US-based medical practice (specialty practice strongly preferred)

• Experience with at least one US EHR system (Athena, eClinicalWorks, Practice Fusion, DrChrono, Kareo, Epic, or similar)

• Working familiarity with HIPAA and secure handling of patient information

• Comfortable using project management and task management tools (Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Trello, 
, or similar)

• Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in everyday work

• Advanced spoken and written English

• Fluent in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar, Gmail)

• Able to overlap 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM US Pacific Time daily



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience writing standard operating procedures or operational documentation for a medical practice

• Cardiology, electrophysiology, or internal medicine practice experience specifically

• Experience supporting a solo physician or small specialty practice

• Experience during a practice launch or early-stage phase

• Experience with multiple EHR systems

• Experience with insurance credentialing or prior authorization workflows

• Clinical background (RN, medical scribe, or similar) that complements administrative experience



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

• Monthly salary: ?85,000 – ?106,000 (USD $8–10 per hour), depending on experience

• Monthly HMO allowance of ?6,150 (USD $100) after 90-day probationary period

• Paid time off after 90 days

• Paid weekly or biweekly via Wise or preferred PH-friendly payment method

• Annual performance review with structured opportunities for compensation growth



WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS

• Quiet, dedicated workspace

• Modern computer capable of comfortable multitasking and video conferencing

• Headset suitable for professional video calls

title: CREDIT REPAIR OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
CREDIT REPAIR OPERATIONS MANAGER



Full-Time · Remote · Immediate Start



$8.38/hr · $1,826/month · 8 hrs/day · Mon–Fri



Goal-Driven · Project Management · Credit repair · Team Leadership  





THE OPPORTUNITY



We're hiring one person who can own outcomes, not just tasks — someone who has run a full credit repair operation, understands the law, and can build systems that scale.



In the early stage you'll execute the work yourself. As we grow, you'll build the team around you and manage it. This role has a direct path to Head of Operations as the company scales past $50K MRR.





GOALS YOU'LL OWN



You will be measured on results. These are the targets that define success in this role:



1. Dispute letters submitted for all newly activated clients — within 5 business days of activation, every time  

2. FCRA 30-day deadline compliance across all active files — zero overdue responses, tracked weekly  

3. Client results per 90-day dispute cycle — ?3 deletions or corrections per client  

4. Monthly result reports delivered to all active clients — 100% on time, zero missed  

5. FCRA compliance rate on all dispute letters — zero non-compliant letters, QA before every send  

6. Core SOPs built and documented — dispute, onboarding, QA, and escalation by Day 30  

7. New hires certified before touching live client files — 100% trained and QA-cleared, no exceptions





PROJECT MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES



You will manage multiple active workstreams simultaneously. This is not a task-execution role — it is a results-delivery role.



- Manage 20–60 active client files as parallel projects, each with its own dispute strategy, FCRA deadline calendar, and monthly deliverable  

- Build and own the company SOP library: dispute workflow, client onboarding, escalation process, and QA checklist — from a blank page  

- Coordinate across departments on client handoffs — enrolled ? activated ? results delivered ? billed  

- Design and execute the new hire training program for Credit Restoration; define 30/60/90-day KPIs for each hire before their start date  

- Maintain the weekly KPI dashboard for Credit Restoration; present results to the CEO every Monday  

- Identify operational gaps across departments; design interim coverage and document the handoff plan for each





CREDIT RESTORATION OPERATIONS



- Pull tri-merge reports via IdentityIQ; audit all three bureaus; tag every negative item by type, dispute reason, and FCRA path  

- Draft §609, §611, and §623 dispute letters using Factual, FTC, and Metro 2 Compliance methods — no fraudulent disputes, ever  

- Submit to bureaus via certified mail or portal; own the 30-day FCRA deadline calendar for every active client  

- Escalate to §623 furnisher disputes and CFPB complaints when bureaus fail to investigate or correct properly  

- Produce monthly result reports for every active client: items disputed, deleted, updated, score change estimate, and next 30-day plan





WHAT YOU BRING



- 8–10+ years hands-on credit repair — you have personally run the full dispute workflow  

- Deep knowledge of FCRA, FDCPA, CROA, CFPB, §609, §611, §623, and 15 U.S.C. §1666B  

- Proven Metro 2 Compliance methodology experience — letter generation and the furnisher dispute process  

- Credit Repair Cloud (CRC) proficiency — pipeline, workflow automation, and client file management without training  

- Experience building SOPs and managing a dispute, processing, or customer support team  

- Familiarity with FDCPA violation filings, FCRA violation complaints, and debt defense document drafting  

- Strong written English; excellent communicator with US-based clients and bureaus  



TOOLS



Required: Credit Repair Cloud · DisputeBee · IdentityIQ · RingCentral  



Preferred: Client Dispute Manager · Dispute Fox · Prodigy · Dispute Panda · GoHighLevel · Zoho · QuickBooks  



Monitoring: IdentityIQ · Smart Credit · MyScoreIQ · Credit Karma · Annual Credit Report  





COMPENSATION



- Pay Rate: $8.38 USD/hour  

- Type: Full-Time · Remote · Permanent  

- Schedule: Monday to Friday · US business hours  

- Start: Immediate — within 2 weeks of offer  



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application with:



1. Your resume with all credit repair software and dispute methods you've used  

2. A 150–250 word written summary: your dispute workflow experience and the largest team or caseload you've managed  

3. Optional: a sample dispute letter or SOP you've written



Applications without the written summary will not be reviewed.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
# Executive & Personal Assistant to Founder



I’m hiring a personal executive assistant to work directly with me and help run the practical parts of my life.



This is a high-trust role. I’m looking for someone who can handle my schedule, travel, appointments, vendors, errands, reservations, events, follow-ups, and the many small things that otherwise sit in my head.



The right person is organized, discreet, loyal, fast, calm, and hard to fluster. You should have good taste, strong judgment, and the ability to figure things out without needing every step explained.



This is not a normal admin job. You will be close to how I operate day to day. You will see personal details, private conversations, family logistics, business matters, and sensitive information. Discretion is required.



## What you’ll handle



You will help with both personal and professional logistics, including:



* Managing my calendar and daily schedule

* Coordinating travel, transportation, hotels, restaurants, and itineraries

* Booking appointments, reservations, dinners, events, and experiences

* Handling errands, purchases, returns, gifting, and personal tasks

* Managing household vendors, service providers, and recurring logistics

* Keeping track of follow-ups, reminders, deadlines, and open loops

* Preparing me for meetings, calls, trips, and events

* Communicating with people on my behalf when needed

* Creating simple systems so things do not fall through the cracks

* Taking on special projects as they come up



Some days will be structured. Some days will change quickly. I need someone who can adapt without getting thrown off.



## What I’m looking for



I’m looking for someone who takes pride in being excellent at the details.



You should be the kind of person who notices when something is slightly off, follows up without being chased, and thinks two steps ahead. You should be comfortable making judgment calls, but also know when something needs to be escalated.



Strong candidates will be:



* Very organized

* Discreet

* Loyal

* Calm under pressure

* Fast to respond

* Good at written communication

* Comfortable around high-performing people

* Comfortable with personal tasks

* Good with vendors, hospitality, scheduling, and logistics

* Detail-oriented without being rigid

* Resourceful when the answer is not obvious



You do not need to have done this exact role before, but you do need to have high standards.



## This role is probably not for you if



* You need a predictable 9-to-5 environment

* You dislike personal errands or lifestyle-related work

* You need every task fully documented before starting

* You are uncomfortable with confidentiality

* You get overwhelmed when plans change

* You are casual about follow-through

* You think “assistant” means waiting to be told what to do



## Compensation and long-term upside



I want this to be a long-term role.



For the right person, compensation will increase meaningfully over time with trust, loyalty, responsibility, and performance. The more useful and dependable you become, the more the role can grow.



I believe in taking care of people who take care of me. If you become someone I can rely on completely, there is no fixed ceiling on where this can go.



This is a role for someone who wants to build real trust over years, not months.



## Ideal background



Helpful experience may include:



* Personal assistant work

* Executive assistant work

* Hospitality

* Private client service

* Family office support

* Founder or entrepreneur support

* Event planning

* Travel coordination

* Household management

* Operations-heavy roles



The most important qualities are judgment, loyalty, discretion, speed, and taste.



## How to apply



Please send:



* A short note about yourself

* Relevant experience

* Where you are based

* Your availability

* A few examples of situations where you had to organize something complex, handle a sensitive matter, or solve a problem without much direction



I care more about quality, trust, and reliability than a perfect resume.

title: Video Editor (Junior to Senior Track) | Short-Form Reels | Long-Term Role with a Creative-First Agency
description:
Company: MORPHOS | Full-Service Creative Agency

Role Type: Part-time to start, growing into full-time

Schedule: Your choice | 8am–5pm Philippine time OR 8am–5pm PST, Monday–Friday

Rate: $8–$12/hour USD, based on skill and experience

Software: Adobe Premiere Pro (primary)



--- Read this before you apply:



Most agencies hire editors to push buttons. We don't.



MORPHOS is a creative-first, AI-second agency. That means we lead with taste, craft, and creative authority and we use AI to move faster, not to replace the human eye behind the work. If you're the kind of editor who actually cares about the why behind a cut, the rhythm of a hook, or whether a piece of typography earns its place on the screen, keep reading.



This is a junior editor role with a real senior-editor path. I'm a video editor and creative director myself, so early on you won't be expected to carry the full creative load. What I need right now is a sharp, fast, technically clean executor who can take direction, deliver revisions with precision, and grow into someone I trust to make creative calls without me in the room.

If that growth path matters to you, we're aligned.



--- What you'll be editing



· Primarily Instagram Reels --- short-form, vertical, cinematic

· Some YouTube content over time as the role expands

· Footage is shot intentionally --- often 4K, often cinematic, often LUT-graded

· You'll be working with footage from MORPHOS itself and from our clients (notably an aesthetics and wellness brand with a strong visual identity)



--- What I need from you (Requirements)



Technical Skills:

· Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro (other editing software is acceptable as long as you can render to spec and collaborate cleanly)

· Strong typography sensibility --- captions, kinetic text, and on-screen titles should feel intentional, readable, and never overwhelming. Sometimes simple captions. Sometimes animated text. You should know the difference.

· Speed with quality. I don't want fast and sloppy. I don't want slow and precious. I want efficient and excellent.

· Comfortable receiving and executing revisions with high accuracy



--- Communication



· Strong written and spoken English. You need to understand feedback the first time, ask sharp questions when something's unclear, and communicate proactively when something's blocking you.

· Take feedback with humility and accuracy. Humility without accuracy means we redo the same revision twice. Accuracy without humility means we fight about taste. I want both.



? Setup



· Internet speed: minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload. Faster is better. You'll be pulling down multi-gigabyte files regularly? sometimes hundreds of gigabytes in a working week.

· Hard drive space: you need enough free space to handle 4K footage from day one. I'll cover a dedicated external drive for you within the first few weeks of hiring, but you need to be able to work with the footage we send during the trial and onboarding period.

· A computer that can actually edit 4K without crashing every twenty minutes



--- Bonus skills (not required, but they'll move you up the list)



· Color correction and grading proficiency

· Experience working with LUTs on cinematic 4K footage

· Working knowledge of other Adobe Suite tools --- After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom

· Graphic design skills or instincts (we're a full-service shop, and editors who can think visually beyond the timeline grow fastest here)

· Familiarity with motion graphics or template-based animation



--- Compensation & Growth



· Starting rate: $8–$12/hour USD, based on demonstrated skill and experience

· A paid trial edit is part of the hiring process --- you'll be compensated for your time whether or not we move forward together

· External hard drive provided once we commit to working together long-term

· Rate increases tied to loyalty, output quality, and growth into senior responsibilities

· My goal is to pay above industry standard for the right person --- but I need to see proof in the pudding first. Loyalty and consistency over time unlock the ceiling.



I'm not looking for a quick hire. I'm looking for someone who wants to be here in two years.



--- Schedule (your choice)

I believe in work-life balance. I know night shifts are common for Philippine VAs, but they're hard on your health long-term, so I'm giving you the choice:



Option A: 8am–5pm Philippine Standard Time, Monday–Friday

Option B: 8am–5pm Pacific Standard Time, Monday–Friday



Whichever serves your life better. Pick the one you can sustain.



--- How to apply

Send the following --- and please follow the format, because attention to instructions is part of the evaluation:



· A short intro --- who you are, where you're based, why this role caught your eye (a paragraph, not an essay)

· A portfolio link --- Google Drive, Vimeo, YouTube, or a personal site. I want to see at least 3 recent short-form vertical edits (Reels, TikToks, or Shorts) you've actually edited. I recommend you only send 3-5 videos of your best work.

· Your editing software of choice and your years of experience with it

· Your internet speed test result (screenshot from speedtest.net is fine)

· Which schedule (Option A or B) you're applying for

· Your hourly rate expectation within the $8–$12 range, and one sentence on why you land where you land



Top applicants will receive a paid trial edit using real footage from our pipeline. The trial is paid regardless of outcome.



--- A final note



If you want a job where you clock in, push the right buttons, and clock out...this isn't it.



If you want to grow inside a creative agency that takes craft seriously, uses AI as a tool not a crutch, and actually pays you what you're worth as you level up --- apply.



I'm looking forward to seeing your work.



Caleb

Founder & Creative Director, MORPHOS

title: Real Estate Content Creator – Video Reels Editor
description:
Hi Im Francesca, and I'm looking for a creative and skilled video editor who can transform professional videography footage into dynamic, engaging property reels that capture attention and keep viewers watching on a long-term, recurring basis.



You will receive raw footage shot by our professional videographers and turn it into short-form video content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. The goal is to create a cinematic walkthrough-style flow, guiding viewers through the property in a way that feels immersive, polished, and compelling.

This is not basic slideshow editing. We want reels that tell a story and make someone feel like they are already walking through their future home.



About the work:

I have clients in real estate and I need an editor who can handle the full content creation so I can focus on the client relationship. If we work well together, this will be steady, predictable monthly work, and I'm open to bringing you more clients as I grow.



What You Will Do

Edit professional raw footage into polished, dynamic property reels (15–60 seconds)

Build a smooth walkthrough flow that guides viewers room to room with intentional pacing and transitions

Use AI tools and/or editing software to enhance footage and create motion effects

Add music, sound design, text overlays, and motion graphics suited to the property's style and price point

Deliver content optimized for vertical format (9:16) for Reels and TikTok

Maintain a consistent visual brand across all property content

Please add the word banana somewhere in your application so I know you have reviewed the entire listing.

Stay current on trending reel formats, transitions, and audio styles that perform well in real estate content





Requirements

Proven experience editing short-form video reels  a portfolio or sample work is required to apply

Proficiency in at least one editing platform: CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

Experience using AI-assisted editing tools such as CapCut AI, Runway ML, or similar

Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, and visual flow

Ability to match editing style and tone to the property type (starter home vs. luxury listing)

Fast turnaround ability to deliver within 48 to 72 hours per property

Reliable internet connection and clear communication





Nice to Have

Experience editing real estate, architecture, or interior design content

Motion graphics or After Effects skills

Drone footage editing experience

Ability to add AI voiceover or narration for walkthrough-style videos





What We Provide

High-quality raw footage from professional videographers

Property details and key selling points for each listing

Brand guidelines and creative direction

Ongoing work for the right candidate





Compensation

Per project / per property - will be a package deal of between 5-25 reels) rate negotiable based on experience and the number of reels per listing. Please include your rate expectation when applying.



How to Apply

Send a message with the following:

Links to 2–3 reels or video edits you have created (real estate preferred but not required)

The editing software and AI tools you use

Your turnaround time and availability

Your rate per reel or per property

title: InDesign Workbook Layout Designer (3-Week Project, Immediate Start)
description:
The opportunity



We're an education company based in Australia that creates practical learning kits for young entrepreneurs. Our products include card decks, handbooks, workbooks, and online courses sold globally.



We need an experienced InDesign designer to lay out a series of print-ready workbooks across our product range. The content is written. The InDesign templates are purchased. We need someone who can bring the two together quickly and professionally.



This is a focused 3-week engagement starting immediately, with the potential for ongoing work as we release new products throughout the year.



What you'll be doing



Taking fully written workbook content (provided as Word documents with clear structure) and laying it out in InDesign using pre-purchased templates. Each workbook contains exercises with writable fields, tables, reflection prompts, and planning spaces designed for the reader to fill in by hand.



Specifically:



- Laying out 4-5 workbooks (ranging from 75 to 100 exercises each, approximately
pages per book)

- Adapting InDesign templates to match our existing visual identity (bold, energetic, yellow and black palette)

- Setting up consistent page templates for different exercise types (tables, write-in fields, grids, reflection pages)

- Creating phase divider pages and section openers

- Ensuring all content is print-ready for our print-on-demand supplier (correct bleed, margins, trim, and export settings)

- Exporting final PDFs to print-on-demand specifications



What we provide



- Complete written content for each workbook (structured Word documents with every exercise, heading, and instruction)

- InDesign templates as your starting point

- Our existing visual identity and brand guidelines (colour palette, typography direction, examples of our published handbook)

- Clear feedback and direction throughout the project

- A collaborative working relationship with fast turnaround on approvals



Skills required



- Strong proficiency in Adobe InDesign (this is 95% of the job)

- Experience laying out books, workbooks, educational materials, or course content for print

- Understanding of print-on-demand specifications (bleed, safe zones, spine calculations, PDF/X export)

- Clean, readable typography and layout instincts

- Ability to create and modify master pages, paragraph styles, and character styles efficiently

- Comfortable working from Word documents and adapting content to designed layouts

- Good communication in English

- Available to start within the next few days



Nice to have



- Experience with Bookvault, IngramSpark, KDP, or similar print-on-demand platforms

- Basic Figma literacy (our card designs live in Figma, though this role is InDesign-focused)



Working arrangement



- 3-week project, starting as soon as possible

- Estimated 20-30 hours per week depending on pace

- We work on Australian Eastern time (AEST/AEDT) but are flexible on hours as long as communication is responsive during overlapping windows

- All work delivered via shared cloud folder (Google Drive)

- Regular check-ins via chat or video call



How to apply



Please include:



1. Your portfolio or samples showing book/workbook/educational layout work in InDesign (this is the most important thing)

2. A brief note on your experience with print-ready production and any print-on-demand platforms you've worked with

3. Your availability over the next 3 weeks and your hourly or project rate

4. How soon you could start



We're looking for someone who takes pride in clean, professional layout work and can move quickly with clear direction. If you've laid out educational content, workbooks, or course materials before, you're exactly who we're looking for.

title: Video Editor - VA
description:
If you've been looking for a long-term role with a fast-growing US brand in the masculine wellness space, read carefully.



Joburn and our team has generated over seven million dollars for clients in the past couple of years. We're just getting started. Now we're placing trained operators into the brands we know best — and this is one of those roles.



THE BRAND: BEEFCAKE WELLNESS



Brandon Bohonko runs Beefcake Wellness. 100,000+ followers across Instagram and TikTok. He gained 70 lbs on purpose to understand what his clients were going through, then started losing it publicly. He documents the whole arc.



Posts 5-6 short-form vertical videos per week. The audience is fitness-curious men 25-45 who know what to do and aren't doing it.



The brand voice is loose, masculine, lightly profane, period-driven. Lowercase captions. Self-aware. Anti-hype. Think Sam Sulek + Greg Doucette's editing style. Fast cuts, on-screen text that does the work the voice doesn't, music that drives pacing. If you don't already get this register, watch 10 videos 
 
 before applying.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Edit 5-6 short-form vertical videos per week (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts)

60-90 seconds per video typically

Add cuts, b-roll overlays, on-screen text, music, captions

Match Brandon's visual style. You'll get a 20-video reference set plus a style guide.

Repurpose long-form podcast or interview footage into 3-5 shorts per session

Manage a simple weekly Trello or Notion board of pending vs shipped

48-hour standard turnaround on regular edits, 24-hour on priority

You're embedded directly with Brandon's content operation. Not subcontracted. Not white-labeled. You are his editor, daily.



REQUIRED



2+ years editing short-form vertical video for social platforms

CapCut Pro fluency. Brandon edits rough on iPhone, you finish on desktop.

Adobe Premiere Pro OR DaVinci Resolve at an intermediate level

Native or near-native English. You'll write on-screen text and clean captions.

Stable internet, GMT+8 hours or compatible overlap with Pacific or Mountain time

Hook-first editing instinct. The first 1.5 seconds is the entire game.

Ability to take a 1-paragraph brief plus raw footage and produce a publishable edit

NICE TO HAVE



Thumbnail design for YouTube

Familiarity with fitness or bodybuilding content

Comfortable with profanity and irreverent humor (this IS the brand voice)

Loom recording for async feedback exchange

WHO WE WANT (AND WHO WE DON'T)



We hire on three things. Read these honestly. If they don't sound like you, don't apply. We'd rather you save the time.



1. Radical candor. We tell you when something is off. We expect you to tell us back. No sugar-coating. No "great question!" energy. We just talk. If you need a soft work culture, this isn't it.



2. Extreme ownership. Your edit shipped late? That's on you. The brief was unclear? You should have asked. The team will not hand-hold. The good news: when something works, the credit is also yours.



3. Willingness to move. Speed beats prestige. 10 cuts in 48 hours beats one perfect edit in two weeks. If you need to polish something for a week before shipping, you'll be miserable here.



And one more thing. The honest reason we're hiring this way.



AI is coming for video editing. Not slowly. We see it. The editors who survive the next 18 months will be the ones who use AI as a leverage tool but keep their own taste on top. The ones who don't will be replaced.

title: Content Creator
description:
We are looking for someone to work full time as a Social Media Content Manager/Video Editor with at least 2-3 years experience managing socials for brands and/or creators.  Must also have.....



1. A strong foundation starts with visual storytelling — knowing how to frame a narrative, build tension or interest across a short-form clip, and hook an audience in the first two seconds. 



2. Photography and videography basics — composition rules (rule of thirds, leading lines), lighting fundamentals (natural vs. artificial, three-point lighting), and camera settings if shooting on a DSLR or mirrorless. Even shooting on a phone benefits from understanding these principles. 



3. Copywriting — writing captions that complement visuals, not just describe them. This includes understanding platform-specific voice (TikTok is conversational, LinkedIn is more measured) and basic SEO for hashtags and keywords.



4. Graphic design — creating thumbnails, story graphics, and overlays. Tools like Canva cover most needs, but knowing Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop opens more doors.



5. Brand consistency — maintaining a recognizable visual identity across posts: consistent color palettes, fonts, and tone.



6. Trend awareness — knowing how to identify a trend early, adapt it to your niche, and execute before it peaks.



7. Video Editing skills that include

a. Cuts and pacing — the ability to trim fat from footage, time cuts to music or speech rhythm, and control the emotional pace of a video. Good editing is mostly invisible; bad editing loses viewers instantly.

b. Color grading — applying LUTs or manual color correction to give footage a consistent, polished look. Even basic warmth/contrast adjustments make a big difference.

c. Audio editing — cleaning up background noise, syncing audio, mixing music levels so voiceover is always audible, and using royalty-free music sources (Epidemic Sound, Artlist).

d. Text and captions — adding animated subtitles (CapCut auto-captions are common), lower thirds, and kinetic text. e. Captions are no longer optional — most short-form video is watched without sound.

e. Motion and transitions — knowing when a transition adds energy versus when a simple cut is cleaner. Jump cuts, whip pans, and match cuts each serve specific purposes.

f. Platform-specific export — understanding aspect ratios (9:16 for Reels/TikTok, 1:1 for feed, 16:9 for YouTube), resolution requirements, and file sizes for each platform.

title: Content Operations Specialist (B2B SaaS, Remote)
description:
ABOUT US



We are a UK-based organic growth agency for B2B SaaS companies. We help

clients show up in AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) and traditional

Google search through content, SEO, and digital PR. Our clients are funded

B2B SaaS companies, 20-500 employees, US and UK.



We will share more about who we are at the interview stage.



THE ROLE



The Content Operations Specialist exists to turn AI-drafted content into

published, indexed, distributed assets that move the needle for our

clients. You own the production layer end-to-end. You report directly to

the founder.



This is not a writing role. AI handles first drafts. Your job is to take

those drafts and ship them at volume — edited to our voice, published

clean, indexed fast, repurposed for distribution, and tracked for

performance.



We are a high-output operation. Slow content shops are not a fit.



This role is the foundation of our content engine. The right person will

grow with the agency as we scale from one to multiple clients, with clear

paths into content leadership or operations management within 12 months.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Take AI-drafted blog posts and edit them to publish-ready quality using

  our writing rules document (banned words, voice patterns, structure)

- Publish to our CMS (WordPress) with full on-page SEO: meta title, meta

  description, schema markup, internal links, OG image, alt text

- Submit each post to Google Search Console for indexing

- Repurpose long-form blogs into LinkedIn text posts (no design work

  required — visuals handled separately)

- Pull monthly performance numbers from Google Search Console and Google

  Analytics 4 into our reporting template

- QA our link builder's placements (DR and relevance checks)

- Light keyword research using DataForSEO and Ahrefs

- Add visuals, screenshots, and alt text to every post before publish



REQUIREMENTS



- 2-3 years of content production and publishing experience (B2B tech,

  SaaS, agencies, professional services, or similar)

- Hands-on experience with a real CMS — WordPress is what we use, but

  Webflow, HubSpot, or Ghost mastery is acceptable

- Native or near-native English writing

- Demonstrated experience editing AI-generated content (ChatGPT, Claude)

- Comfort with Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4

- Basic SEO knowledge (on-page, meta, internal linking, schema markup)

- Detail-oriented — you spot em dashes, "delve," and "leverage" from

  across the room



STRONGLY PREFERRED (not required)



- B2B SaaS content experience specifically

- Familiarity with AI search platforms (Perplexity, ChatGPT citations)

- Worked with a marketing agency before



RESULTS



- Sustained high-volume publishing cadence, on schedule, without

  reminders

- Zero AI tells in published work — a reader cannot spot the AI origin

- Zero on-page SEO mistakes (no missing schema, no broken internal links,

  no generic meta descriptions)

- Posts indexed in Google Search Console within 48 hours of publish

- LinkedIn repurposing live within 24 hours of blog publish

- Monthly reporting numbers in our template by the 3rd of each month

- Production capacity scales with client base — comfortable owning

  multiple clients' content engines



SCHEDULE



- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- 4-hour overlap with UK working hours required (we operate on GMT)

- Async-friendly outside the overlap window

- Flexibility expected on launch days and client deadlines



LOCATION



Remote, Philippines only.



COMPENSATION



Up to $1,500/month USD, paid monthly via Wise.



HOW TO APPLY



We do not review applications without a video.



STEP 1 — Record a Loom video (60-90 seconds) answering, in order:



1. Your name, country, and timezone (10s)

2. Walk us through the last B2B SaaS blog post you published — what was

   your role, what CMS, what the on-page SEO setup looked like (45s)

3. Name 3 marketing words you think are overused and should never appear

   in blog copy (15s)

4. Why are you a strong fit for this role specifically (20s)



** Say the word "MANGO" at the end of your video. Applications without

   this word in the video will be rejected. **



STEP 2 — Send us:



- Your Loom video link

- Links to 2 published B2B SaaS blog posts you have worked on

- The CMS each was published on

- Your monthly salary expectation in USD

- The word "MANGO" in your application subject line



APPLICATION DEADLINE



[ 7 days from 25/05/26]. We review applications in waves.

Strong candidates may be contacted before the deadline.



PROCESS



Video screen ? paid trial task on real work ? 30-minute video interview ?

reference check ? offer. Two weeks from application to offer.

title: Guest Operations Manager (AI-Assisted, Vacation Rentals)
description:
Guest Operations Manager (AI-Assisted, Vacation Rentals)

Villa Paraiso Vacation Rentals (Miami + Florida Keys)

Remote | Philippines



Pay: $7 to $9 USD/hour starting (based on Guesty operations skill)

Schedule: Friday to Tuesday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time

Philippines time: This is usually 11:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila time (night shift)



About Us

We manage 20+ luxury waterfront vacation rentals in Miami and the Florida Keys.

We run on systems, SOPs, and accountability. Guest messaging is largely automated using HostBuddy AI, so your job is NOT to sit there typing all day.

Your job is to resolve real issues, coordinate the field team, and keep operations clean and on-track.



The Role (What you’ll actually do)

You are the “closer” for daily ops.

HostBuddy AI covers most routine guest communication. You handle escalations, coordination, and follow-through.



Core Responsibilities

1) Issue Resolution and Guest Support (Primary)

- Monitor HostBuddy AI escalations and identify what needs a human

- Handle urgent issues end-to-end: lockouts, WiFi, AC, hot water, noise complaints, access issues

- Coordinate solutions with cleaners, maintenance vendors, and field team

- Keep the guest calm, set expectations, and close the loop once fixed



2) Turnover and Team Coordination

- Confirm checkouts and coordinate cleanings, inspections, and same-day turns

- Handle last-minute changes: late checkouts, early check-in requests, schedule shifts

- Ensure every turnover is completed on time and meets quality standards



3) Systems Management (Guesty + Breezeway)

- Maintain Guesty: reservation changes, guest notes, tasks, internal status updates

- Create and track Breezeway tasks for housekeeping, inspections, maintenance

- Keep trackers updated (Google Sheets) so nothing gets lost

- Flag when automations break and report what happened clearly



Tools You’ll Use

Guesty, Breezeway, HostBuddy AI, 
, Google Workspace, Slack, ChatGPT



Must-Haves (Read carefully)

- 1+ year experience in short-term rental operations, hospitality ops, or property management

- Guesty experience required (real daily use, not “familiar”)

- Strong written English (you will message guests when escalation happens)

- Calm under pressure and good judgment (you don’t panic, you execute)

- Strong follow-through (you close loops and document outcomes)

- Reliable internet + quiet setup (headset, stable computer)

- Full focus during your shift (no other client work during live guest support hours)



Nice to Have

- Breezeway experience

- Vendor coordination experience

- Familiar with STR tools and automations (Zapier/Make/n8n)



After-Hours

Rare (about 1 to 2 times per month), only for true urgent issues like lockouts or emergencies. You are not on-call 24/7.



Training

You will get structured onboarding on our properties, SOPs, and systems before running shifts solo. We want you confident, not guessing.



Growth Path

Top performers can advance to Operations Manager within 12 to 18 months (higher pay, more ownership, team oversight, owner communications, and system projects). Raises are performance-based.



How to Apply (Required)

Start your application message with: Keys Ready

Attach your resume and answer ALL questions below (copy/paste the questions with your answers).



Application Questions

1) Confirm availability: Can you work Friday to Tuesday, 10 AM to 5 PM Eastern Time every week? Yes/No

2) Confirm night shift: What is that schedule in Manila time for you, and are you comfortable long-term? Yes/No

3) Guesty proof: How long have you used Guesty, and what were the last 3 tasks you did inside it?

4) Escalation scenario: Guest says “AC is not working, it’s 85 degrees inside.” Walk through exactly what you do step-by-step.

5) Lockout scenario: Guest is locked out at 9 PM. What do you do step-by-step?

6) Turnover pressure: Cleaner says “Is checkout extended for Unit 7?” and you have a same-day check-in. What do you do and how do you prevent delays?

7) Internet: Paste your download/upload speed and confirm you have a backup internet option.

8) Self-awareness: What part of this job would be hardest for you, and how would you handle it?



Applications that skip questions will not be reviewed.

title: Vacation Rentals Guest Operations Leader
description:
AI-Powered Vacation Rentals Operations Leader

Villa Paraiso Vacation Rentals



Schedule: Friday–Tuesday, 10:00 AM–5:00 PM ET

Rate: $7–10/hour USD based on experience | Growth Path to Operations Manager



About Villa Paraiso

We're a luxury vacation rental company managing 20+ premium waterfront properties across Miami and the Florida Keys. We operate with an AI-forward mindset—leveraging automation, smart workflows, and cutting-edge tools to deliver exceptional guest experiences at scale. We need someone who thrives in that environment.



The Role

This isn't a "just answer messages" position. You'll be the operational backbone of our guest experience—working independently, solving problems in real-time, and keeping our properties running smoothly. You'll use AI tools daily, manage multiple systems, and help us continuously improve how we operate.



A Typical Shift Might Include

Responding to 20-30 guest messages across platforms

Coordinating 3 check-ins and 2 check-outs with the cleaning team

Troubleshooting a WiFi issue with a guest

Updating a reservation in Guesty after a date change

Flagging a maintenance issue in Breezeway

Drafting an owner update
 using Gemini

Working on backend tasks and maintaining listings



What You'll Do

Guest Operations (60%)

Respond to guest inquiries across Airbnb, VRBO, 
, and direct channels with speed and professionalism

Handle check-in/check-out coordination, guest requests, and issue resolution

Manage reservation modifications, cancellations, and special requests in Guesty

Monitor and respond to guest reviews



Systems & Workflow Management (25%)

Maintain Guesty PMS—reservations, listings, messaging, and reporting

Coordinate tasks in Breezeway for housekeeping, inspections, and maintenance

Keep Google Sheets, trackers, and internal documentation updated and accurate

Flag system issues and help troubleshoot when automations break



AI-Enhanced Operations (15%)

Use ChatGPT, Claude, and AI tools to draft responses, solve problems, and work faster

Learn and adapt to new tools quickly as we evolve our tech stack

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks



Vendor & Team Coordination

Route maintenance requests, housekeeping issues, and service calls to our contractor network

Communicate with field team on property needs and urgent situations

Track open issues to completion







Must-Haves:

3+ years in short-term rental operations (vacation rentals, property management, or hospitality)

Guesty PMS experience—non-negotiable (you should know it inside and out)

Fluent strong English communication skills

Hostbuddy ai preferred

Breezeway preferred

Slack preferred

Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) and learning new technology quickly

Highly independent—you see what needs to be done and handle it without being asked

Reliable internet and professional remote work setup



Strong Bonus Points:

Breezeway experience (or similar task management platforms)

Familiar with HostBuddy, StayFi, or other STR tools

Experience with automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make)

Background in hospitality or customer service excellence



What We Offer

Growth Path: Top performers can advance to Operations Manager within 12-18 months, taking on team oversight, owner communications, and strategic projects. We promote from within.

Work with cutting-edge AI tools and help shape our automation strategy

Autonomy and ownership—no micromanagement, just accountability

Fast-paced environment where your problem-solving skills actually matter

Exposure to luxury hospitality in Miami and the Florida Keys



About After-Hours: After-hours needs are rare (1-2x/month) and typically involve urgent guest issues like lockouts or emergencies. We don't expect you to be on-call 24/7—we have systems for that.



Onboarding: You'll get structured training covering our systems, SOPs, and properties before handling guest communications independently.



Not a Fit If

You need constant supervision or step-by-step instructions

You're uncomfortable with technology or resistant to learning new tools

You prefer slow-paced, predictable work

You don't have hands-on Guesty experience



Prescreening Questions

Please answer ALL of the following in your application:



Guesty Knowledge Test

In Guesty, how would you set up an automated message to send check-in instructions 3 days before arrival, but ONLY if the guest has completed their check-in form? Walk me through the specific steps and settings you would use.



Review Response Challenge

A guest leaves a 3-star review saying: "The place was nice but communication was slow and we never got our pool heated." You know the guest never requested pool heat and you responded to all their messages within 15 minutes. Write the actual public response you would post.



AI Skills Demonstration

Using ChatGPT or Claude, draft a response to this guest message:



"Hi, we're arriving Thursday but our flight got moved to 11am arrival. Can we check in early? Also is there a Publix nearby and can we bring our kayak?"

Paste three things: (1) your prompt to the AI, (2) the AI's output, and (3) your final edited version you would actually send to the guest.



Prioritization Scenario

Begin your answer with the words "Here's my approach:" — It's Saturday at 2 PM. You have four things hitting you at once:

A guest is locked out in Key Colony Beach

A cleaning team is asking if the Unit 7 checkout was extended

ing about their June statement

Fast-paced environment where your problem-solving skills actually matter

Exposure to luxury hospitality in Miami and the Florida Keys

title: Short-Form Video Editor (YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Reels)
description:
I post a new video every day and need someone to turn each one into short clips that get watched.



Every morning, around 10am Eastern European Time, there's a fresh video waiting for you. Your job: cut as many strong clips out of it as you can, then schedule them to go live the same day or the next, on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels.



The clips have to hook in the first 2 seconds or people scroll. That's the whole game. Clean captions that match the audio (CapCut or whatever subtitle tool you like), reframed to 9:16 so my face stays centered, the same look on every clip so the channel feels like one channel. Use any editing software you want. I care about the output, not the tool.



If you ever need me to record specific hooks or intros for you, just ask. Happy to.



What I care about, in order: taste, speed, consistency. You spot the 
nts worth clipping. You turn a video around same day or next. You show up every morning without me chasing you.



Nice to have, not dealbreakers. You've edited talking-head or business content before, not just gaming montages. You've used Opus Clip or a similar tool, fine, but I want an editor with judgment, not someone who exports whatever the tool guesses.



Pay is up to $600 a month. Part-time or full-time is your call. Tell me which you want and how many hours that means for you.



To apply:

1. Start your message with the word CLIP so I know you read this. No CLIP, no reply.

2. Send 2 or 3 vertical clips you edited yourself, with captions. Links, not files.

3. In one or two lines, tell me why one of those clips works.



Do those three and I read it. Skip them and I don't.
