title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for Hair Etc., a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, run a proven script, and book them onto the salon's calendar.



If you're a sales-oriented setter who loves high-volume work, runs scripts the way they were written, and is motivated by performance pay tied to real results — keep reading. If you want a low-pressure customer service job or you like "making the script your own," this won't be a fit.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on Hair Etc., a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market. You can see the salon directly:



- Google Maps Listing: 

- Instagram: 



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at Hair Etc. handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script word-for-word for the entire call, from greeting to booking. The only time you go off-script is to answer a client's specific question (directions, timing) or collect unique info.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We say "word-for-word" because that's how the role works — but we want to clear up the most common concern people have about that:



"Won't I sound like a robot if I'm reading a script?"



No. Think about the best actors in your favorite movies. They're saying lines someone else wrote. They don't sound robotic because they've rehearsed enough that the words feel natural, and they bring real warmth, tone, and presence to the delivery. THAT'S EXACTLY WHAT WE'RE AFTER. The script is the structure. Your tone, pacing, and warmth are what make it feel human.



We train for this. You'll rehearse, get coached on tonality and pacing, and review your own call recordings until the words feel like yours — even though they're not. The setters who do this best sound like they're having a natural conversation that just happens to follow a proven path.



The script DOES change over time — but only based on data. If something isn't landing in calls, we test a new version, measure the results, and update the script if it works better. What we don't do is let setters freelance individual changes on the fly, because then we can't tell what's working and what's not.



If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll genuinely consider it. We'll A/B test it together. If the data shows it works better, it becomes the newscript. That's the structured way changes happen here.



If that framing works for you, you'll thrive. If "follow a script and let us measure what works" feels suffocating, this role won't be a fit.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



- Advanced English with minimal accent. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- Strong spoken communication — clear voice, confident on calls, doesn't ramble, not soft-spoken.

- Script discipline. You're comfortable running proven scripts word-for-word in mandatory parts of the call. (See the script section above for context on what this actually means day-to-day.)

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Process-oriented. You follow standardized workflows. If you want to change something, you bring a clear, data-backed suggestion to your manager and wait for a decision.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between May 30 – June 7

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance

title: Marketing and Delivery Assistant
description:
OPULENCE  DESIGNS

Delivery Coordinator + Marketing Assistant

Part-time contractor  ·  Remote, Latin America  ·  10–20 hrs/week



Role type Part-time contractor, 10 to 20 hours per week

Location Remote, anywhere in Latin America

Pay $5 to $7 per hour, based on experience

Start date Immediate, as soon as we find the right fit

Reports to Jill Johnson, Founder

Trial period 30 days

Time zone overlap Minimum 3 hours daily with Mountain Time (Edmonton, Canada)

English level B2 or higher (written, client-facing)



About Opulence Designs

Opulence Designs is a marketing and design consultancy that builds booking systems for high-end event venue owners and event planners. We work with clients running residential and commercial event businesses with budgets above $100k. Our 120-day program installs offer clarity, repositions visuals, runs follow-up sprints, and lands clients new bookings under a system they can run on their own once we step out.



I am Jill, the founder. I built this business from scratch. I run client calls, I write the strategy, I deliver the creative work, and I handle the day-to-day. Right now I am the bottleneck. I need someone next to me who can hold the system in place while I stay focused on the work that only I can do.



What this role is

You are the person who makes sure every client step gets done on time. You track where each client is in their 30-day onboarding, send the reminders, prep the worksheets, and follow up when something is sitting too long. You also help me with marketing prep, billing, scheduling, and the daily admin that keeps the business running.



This is a coordination role. The strategy is mine. The execution belongs to both of us, and your job is to keep it moving every single day.



What you will do in a typical week

A normal week sits in five buckets. Some weeks you will be heavier in one bucket than another, depending on where clients are in their phase.



1. Client delivery and SOP execution

?  Run point on client delivery across our Month 1 to Month 4 process (Onboarding, Offer Clarity, 10-Day Sprint, First Booking).

?  Track every client’s status against the SOP checklist and the Miro client journey board.

?  Send pre-call reminders, prep workbook templates, upload assets to each client’s shared folder, and confirm everything is in place 24 hours before our session.

?  Flag anything sitting longer than it should, before it slips into next week.



2. Marketing prep and content support

?  Build out content calendars in Google Sheets from my voice notes, written outlines, Loom recordings, or short briefs

?  Use ChatGPT or Claude to draft first-pass captions,
 follow-ups, short-form ad copy, and weekly content briefs from the brand voice guide. Most of this writing starts as AI output that you sharpen. You need to prompt cleanly and edit the result so it sounds like Opulence, not like Ai.



3. Billing and admin

?  Send invoices and follow up on outstanding balances through CC360 or Stripe.

?  Track payments against active contracts and flag anything past 7 days overdue.

?  Keep the client roster, contact info, contract dates, and renewal milestones current in our CRM.

?  Update Calendar and send invites to prospective clients. 



4. Scheduling and client communication

?  Schedule and confirm discovery calls, kickoff calls, weekly 1:1s, and create meeting schedule for client working sessions based on where they are at, action item focused. 

?  Respond to basic client admin questions in our shared chat (calendar links, file requests, login resets, meeting prep notes).

?  Send weekly recap notes to clients after each session, pulled from my call summaries.



5. Reporting and weekly review

?  Pull a Monday morning report on inquiries, bookings, payments, and client status so we start the week aligned.

?  Update our internal dashboard with week-over-week numbers.



Who this role is for

?  You are organized to the point that an unchecked task feels physically uncomfortable.

?  You have run admin or client coordination work before, ideally inside a creative agency, marketing firm, hospitality business, or events company.

?  You have a working command of Claude. You can write a clean prompt that gets you 80% of the way there, and you know how to edit AI output so it does not sound like AI.

?  You have a real eye for marketing and sales. You know what a good caption looks like, you can spot when a follow-up sounds desperate, you catch a typo at 50 feet, and you can tell when a subject line is going to flop.

?  You are comfortable in Google Workspace, Miro, Canva, CC360 (or a similar CRM), whatsapp, notion, and Loom.

?  Your written English is strong, B2 or higher. You will be drafting client-facing
s, captions, and reminders in English.

?  You can work 2 to 4 hours per day with a minimum of 3 hours overlapping Mountain Time, Monday through Thursday some weekend availability; Sunday meeting weekly prep call. 



Who this role is not for

?  You want to learn marketing on the job. This role assumes you already have a working eye for it.

?  You need step-by-step instructions for every task. I will give you the SOPs and the brand voice guide. You take it from there.

?  You are juggling three other clients and this is a side hustle. I need consistent presence, same hours, same days.

?  You are uncomfortable holding clients accountable to deadlines. A piece of this job is following up on people who have not returned their workbook.



Bonus points if

?  You have worked with wedding planners, event venues, hospitality groups, or boutique creative agencies before.

?  You have light video editing skills (Reels, TikTok captions, simple cuts in CapCut or Descript, basic captioning work).

?  You have used Notion for project management.

?  You have a working understanding of the wedding and events industry vocabulary.

?  You have built a content calendar from scratch for a previous client.



Tools we use

Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar), Miro, Course Creator 360, Stripe, Adobe Cloud, Canva, ChatGPT, Claude, Notion, and other project management tools.



You do not need expert-level skill in all of them. You need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool inside a week.



Logistics

?  10 to 20 hours per week, with room to grow as the business grows.

?  $5 to $8 USD per hour, paid every two weeks via Wise or Stripe.

?  Contractor agreement with a 30-day trial period.

?  Start date is immediate. I am ready to onboard the right person this month.

?  You bring your own laptop, headset, reliable internet, and a quiet workspace for calls.



How to apply

Send your application to 
 with the subject line: Delivery Coordinator + your first name.

Include the four items below. Applications missing the Loom or the scenario answer will not be reviewed. Apply here 
 as well. 



1.  A short Loom video (90 seconds maximum) telling me why you want this role, what kind of client work you have coordinated before, one moment you are proud of, and the kind of business owner you do your best work for.



2.  A one-paragraph answer to this scenario: A client is supposed to send back their onboarding workbook by Friday so we can run their kickoff call on Monday. It is now Wednesday and they have not returned it. Walk me through exactly what you do, what you say, and what you flag to me.



3.  The name of one tool you have used to track client work, and one sentence on what you liked or did not like about it.



4.  Your hourly rate in USD and how many hours per week you can commit.



I read every application personally. The strongest applications come from people who treat this submission the way they would treat a real client deliverable.



Jill Johnson

Founder, Opulence Designs


  ·  Refining your legacy

title: Legal Operations Coordinator
description:
We are a fast-growing legal support company based in Northern California. We provide process serving, court filing, eFiling, document retrieval, and legal operations support to attorneys and law firms. Our team runs on tight workflows, real-time systems, and a strong culture of follow-through. This is an operational business — accuracy and reliability are everything.



About the Role

This is a real operational support role — not a generic virtual assistant position. As a Legal Operations Coordinator, you will be embedded in our daily operations: managing our CRM, handling client communications, preparing proofs of service, coordinating with field contractors, and keeping our internal workflows on track.

You will not be given vague tasks. You will be given systems, SOPs, and clear responsibilities. Your job is to execute them accurately and consistently, flag issues proactively, and help keep the operation running without gaps or dropped follow-ups.



What You Will Do Day-to-Day

CRM & Case Management



Update and maintain case records in our custom CRM after each action

Enter new client orders accurately with all required fields

Track case status and flag anything overdue or stalled

Ensure data integrity across all active cases



Client Communication



Send status updates to clients when cases are assigned, completed, or delayed

Respond to inbound client
s within defined response time windows

Follow up on pending client approvals, missing information, or overdue payments

Maintain a professional, clear tone in all written communication



Proof & Document Preparation



Prepare and format proofs of service from completed job reports

Organize and file completed documents in the correct folder structure

Verify that proofs match the underlying case details before delivery

Track proof status and follow up with contractors when documentation is missing



Contractor Coordination



Assign incoming service requests to available field contractors

Send job details and confirm acceptance

Follow up on jobs that have not been updated or completed on time

Assist with payroll verification by confirming completed jobs against contractor reports



Operational Reporting & Task Tracking



Maintain daily task logs and end-of-day status summaries

Track open items and ensure nothing slips through the cracks

Flag operational issues or patterns to the operations manager

Support internal process improvements as they are rolled out





What This Role Is Not

This role does not involve sales, cold outreach, social media management, graphic design, or generic administrative work. If you are looking for a varied creative role or a light-touch assistant position, this is not the right fit.

This role is high-volume, detail-intensive, and process-driven. The same types of tasks repeat daily. Excellence here means executing those tasks accurately and on time, every time.



Requirements

Must Have



Excellent written English — clear, professional, and grammatically correct

Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple open tasks

Extreme attention to detail — errors in legal documents have real consequences

Ability to follow SOPs and workflows without needing constant supervision

Reliable internet connection (please include your speed in your application)

title: Google Ads Specialist / Paid Search Execution Lead – Lead Gen Focus, Full-Time, PST Overlap
description:
About SBCAN Search Marketing



SBCAN Search Marketing is a small paid media agency based in California. We specialize in structured Google Ads execution, clean conversion tracking, and performance-focused optimization.



Most of our work is for lead generation, service businesses, SaaS, eCommerce, education, and local/regional campaigns. We care about business results, not just clicks, impressions, or low-cost leads.



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who wants stability, ownership, and growth.



Important: This Is a Focused Full-Time Role



This is not a freelance side project, agency subcontractor role, or extra client account.



We are looking for someone who wants this to become their primary full-time position. We are open to candidates who are currently employed full-time, as long as they are willing to give proper notice and transition into this role if hired.



This role is not a good fit for someone trying to work multiple full-time jobs at the same time or manage a large freelance client roster during working hours.



Individual applicants only. No agencies or subcontracting.



Role Overview



We are hiring a Google Ads Specialist / Paid Search Execution Lead to support campaign builds, optimizations, tracking QA, reporting support, and ongoing account maintenance across multiple client accounts.



You will work directly with the agency owner/strategist. You will not be responsible for speaking with clients, but you must communicate clearly, stay organized, and follow through on tasks without items slipping through the cracks.



In the beginning, you will support existing campaigns, learn our systems, and help with execution. Over time, the goal is for you to own more of the day-to-day paid search execution across accounts.



What This Role Is Really About



Technical Google Ads skill matters, but reliability matters just as much.



We need someone who:



Can focus during working hours

Communicates clearly and consistently

Updates tasks without being chased

Notices details before they become problems

Understands lead quality, not just lead volume

Can follow SOPs but also think critically

Speaks up early when something is unclear or blocked

Wants a stable, long-term role instead of short-term freelance work

Responsibilities

Google Ads Execution



You will help with:



Building and optimizing Google Search campaigns

Managing Performance Max campaigns when appropriate

Reviewing search terms and adding negative keywords

Improving campaign structure, ad groups, keywords, and match types

Writing and testing responsive search ads

Monitoring budgets, pacing, bids, and conversion performance

Reviewing lead quality signals and identifying wasted spend

Flagging landing page or offer issues that may affect conversion quality

Helping with campaign QA before launches

Assisting with Microsoft Ads when needed

Tracking & Measurement



You should be comfortable helping with:



GA4 review and troubleshooting

Google Tag Manager QA

Conversion action checks

Identifying duplicate, weak, or misleading conversion actions

Making sure campaigns are optimizing toward meaningful actions

Communicating tracking issues clearly

Process & Communication



You will also be expected to:



Update tasks daily in ClickUp

Document completed work clearly

Leave notes on campaign changes

Send concise updates when requested

Ask questions early instead of guessing

Follow internal checklists and SOPs

Communicate when priorities need clarification

Secondary Paid Social Support



Google Ads is the primary focus, but some support may include:



Meta campaign builds

LinkedIn campaign builds

Creative testing support

Basic paid social monitoring

What Success Looks Like



You will be successful in this role if:



Campaigns are structured cleanly

Search terms are reviewed consistently

Negative keyword lists are maintained

Tracking issues are caught early

Tasks are completed without repeated reminders

Account changes are documented clearly

Lead quality improves, not just lead volume

The agency owner can trust that execution details are being handled

Requirements

Strong hands-on Google Ads experience

Experience with Google Search lead generation campaigns

Experience managing accounts with at least $5,000/month in ad spend

Strong understanding of campaign structure, match types, search terms, negatives, bidding, and conversion tracking

Experience with GA4 and Google Tag Manager

Good written English

Strong attention to detail

Organized and process-oriented

Comfortable working inside ClickUp, Google Sheets, and SOPs

Available for daily PST overlap

Nice to Have

Microsoft Ads experience

Meta Ads experience

LinkedIn Ads experience

Local service business lead gen experience

SaaS lead gen experience

Landing page/CRO feedback experience

Call tracking or CRM tracking experience

Hours & Compensation

Full-time

40 hours/week

Must overlap with PST business hours at least 4 hours per day

Compensation: $2,000–$2,700/month USD, depending on experience and fit

Long-term growth opportunity

Salary reviews available based on reliability, communication, and performance

Loyalty/13th-month-style bonus available after 12 months for strong performance

To Apply



Please answer all questions carefully. Applications that do not answer every question will not be considered.



Start your application with the word Focus so we know you read the full post.

Describe how you would structure a $10,000/month Google Search campaign for a local or regional service business where lead quality matters more than lead volume. Include campaign structure, match types, bidding strategy, and how you would manage negatives.

If a campaign is generating leads at a good cost per lead, but the client says the leads are low quality, what would you check first?

Confirm your availability for PST overlap. What hours could you consistently work?

How many Google Ads accounts or clients are you currently managing?

Are you currently working a full-time job, part-time job, agency role, or recurring freelance/client work? Please explain clearly.

If hired, would this role become your primary full-time position? If you are currently employed, what notice period would you need?

What is the largest monthly Google Ads budget you have personally managed?

Briefly describe one example where you improved lead quality, not just cost per lead. Please do not include confidential client information.



We review applications carefully and are looking for someone serious about long-term growth, focus, and high-quality execution.

title: Video Editor
description:
If you've been looking for a long-term role with a fast-growing US brand in the masculine wellness space, read carefully.



Joburn and our team has generated over seven million dollars for clients in the past couple of years. We're just getting started. Now we're placing trained operators into the brands we know best — and this is one of those roles.



THE BRAND: BEEFCAKE WELLNESS



Brandon Bohonko runs Beefcake Wellness. 100,000+ followers across Instagram and TikTok. He gained 70 lbs on purpose to understand what his clients were going through, then started losing it publicly. He documents the whole arc.



Posts 5-6 short-form vertical videos per week. The audience is fitness-curious men 25-45 who know what to do and aren't doing it.



The brand voice is loose, masculine, lightly profane, period-driven. Lowercase captions. Self-aware. Anti-hype. Think Sam Sulek + Greg Doucette's editing style. Fast cuts, on-screen text that does the work the voice doesn't, music that drives pacing. If you don't already get this register, watch 10 videos 
 
 before applying.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Edit 5-6 short-form vertical videos per week (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts)

60-90 seconds per video typically

Add cuts, b-roll overlays, on-screen text, music, captions

Match Brandon's visual style. You'll get a 20-video reference set plus a style guide.

Repurpose long-form podcast or interview footage into 3-5 shorts per session

Manage a simple weekly Trello or Notion board of pending vs shipped

48-hour standard turnaround on regular edits, 24-hour on priority

You're embedded directly with Brandon's content operation. Not subcontracted. Not white-labeled. You are his editor, daily.



REQUIRED



2+ years editing short-form vertical video for social platforms

CapCut Pro fluency. Brandon edits rough on iPhone, you finish on desktop.

Adobe Premiere Pro OR DaVinci Resolve at an intermediate level

Native or near-native English. You'll write on-screen text and clean captions.

Stable internet, GMT+8 hours or compatible overlap with Pacific or Mountain time

Hook-first editing instinct. The first 1.5 seconds is the entire game.

Ability to take a 1-paragraph brief plus raw footage and produce a publishable edit

NICE TO HAVE



Thumbnail design for YouTube

Familiarity with fitness or bodybuilding content

Comfortable with profanity and irreverent humor (this IS the brand voice)

Loom recording for async feedback exchange

WHO WE WANT (AND WHO WE DON'T)



We hire on three things. Read these honestly. If they don't sound like you, don't apply. We'd rather you save the time.



1. Radical candor. We tell you when something is off. We expect you to tell us back. No sugar-coating. No "great question!" energy. We just talk. If you need a soft work culture, this isn't it.



2. Extreme ownership. Your edit shipped late? That's on you. The brief was unclear? You should have asked. The team will not hand-hold. The good news: when something works, the credit is also yours.



3. Willingness to move. Speed beats prestige. 10 cuts in 48 hours beats one perfect edit in two weeks. If you need to polish something for a week before shipping, you'll be miserable here.



And one more thing. The honest reason we're hiring this way.



AI is coming for video editing. Not slowly. We see it. The editors who survive the next 18 months will be the ones who use AI as a leverage tool but keep their own taste on top. The ones who don't will be replaced.



We want to help you survive that. This role isn't just an editing job. It's training to become an AI-augmented operator. We pay for the work. The skill upgrade is a side effect of how we work.



PAY



$3/hr × 40 hrs/wk = $480/mo to start. Rate reviews are based on performance, reliability, and the brand's growth. No specific bumps promised. Strong editors who fit the team can grow with the brand over time. Piece-rate option also on the table for the right person.



One last thing before the apply step. Brandon's a fitness guy. He likes seeing what people actually eat. Put your favorite food in the subject line of your reply. Catches the people who read carefully too.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — this is the only application we review):



Reply to this post. We personally watch every reply.



In your reply, include:



Your portfolio. Links to 5 short-form videos you've edited (Reels, TikToks, Shorts).

A 60-second Loom introducing yourself and explaining why this specific brand interests you.

One specific video 
 
 you'd improve, and how.

We're looking to make this hire within 5 business days. If we move forward with you, we'll be in touch fast.



Not looking for a one-project freelancer. Looking for an editor who grows with this brand for 12-24 months minimum.



John

on behalf of Beefcake Wellness

title: E-commerce Finance & Operations Analyst (Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Finance & Operations Analyst to support multiple growing e-commerce brands.



This is a long-term position for someone who is excellent with numbers, highly organized, proactive, and experienced with e-commerce operations. You should be comfortable building and improving systems independently without needing step-by-step instructions.



What You’ll Be Doing



Daily Tasks:

- Track and organize daily business expenses

- Monitor bank transactions and subscriptions

- Maintain and update financial records

- Keep inventory and stock data accurate and up-to-date

- Organize invoices and receipts into the correct folders/systems

- Update Google Sheets and internal tracking systems



Weekly Tasks:

- Prepare a clear weekly finance and operations report

- Summarize spending, subscriptions, cash flow, and stock movements

- Identify unusual costs, inconsistencies, or opportunities for improvement

- Ensure all financial/admin work is fully updated by the end of each week



What We’re Looking For

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Advanced experience with Google Sheets / Excel

- Ability to build spreadsheets and systems independently

- Experience working with e-commerce businesses (Shopify, Amazon, etc.)

- Strong attention to detail and organization

- Good communication skills in English

- Self-managing and proactive

- Comfortable handling confidential financial information



Important

We are not looking for someone who needs constant guidance or training. You should already understand how to structure reports, organize financial data, and improve workflows independently.



Position Details

- Part-time

- Flexible schedule

- A few hours per day + one longer reporting day per week

- Long-term opportunity for the right person



Nice to Have

- Experience with inventory management

- Experience with bookkeeping/admin support

- Experience with e-commerce reporting and KPI tracking

- Familiarity with tools like Shopify, Wise, PayPal, Stripe, or accounting software



To Apply



Please answer the following questions in detail:



1. What  kind of e-commerce brands or stores have you worked with before?

2. What were your responsibilities in those roles?

3. Which tools and software are you most experienced with?

title: Webflow Developer
description:
Leapify is an AI creative ad studio that helps businesses create better ads faster. Today, our core product helps users turn their products, services, and offers into ready-to-use ad creatives without needing to write prompts, hire a creative team, or start from scratch every time. We are also building toward a larger vision: a business super app with multiple AI-powered modules for business owners, including AI caller, automation, CRM, follow-up, scheduling, and other tools that help companies run and grow more efficiently.



We are looking for a strong Webflow developer to help us build and develop the Leapify website. This will be a one-time website project, but we are moving fast and will likely have more pages, landing pages, and product module pages coming soon. We need someone who is not just a basic Webflow builder. We need someone who understands clean Webflow development, responsive design, SEO, page speed, CMS structure, and how to build a website that looks polished and converts.



Responsibilities:

- Build and develop the Leapify website in Webflow based on our copy, direction, brand references, and design assets.

- Create a clean, modern, responsive website that works across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

- Help structure the website for SEO, including proper headings, meta titles, meta descriptions, alt text, URL structure, internal linking, and clean page structure.

- Build scalable pages that can support future product modules such as AI caller, automation, CRM, scheduling, and other business tools.

- Set up CMS collections if needed for blogs, landing pages, case studies, module pages, or future content.

- Optimize the site for speed, usability, and conversion.

- Make sure the website is easy for our team to update after launch.

- Bring a good eye for layout, spacing, hierarchy, and user experience.

- Help improve the website where needed, instead of only building exactly what is handed over.

- Connect forms, buttons, tracking pixels, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other basic integrations if needed.



Requirements:

- Strong Webflow development experience.

- Good understanding of responsive design.

- Experience building modern SaaS, AI, startup, or software websites.

- Ability to take direction and turn it into a polished website.

- Understanding of SEO best practices inside Webflow.

- Experience with CMS collections, reusable components, symbols, and clean class naming.

- Ability to build fast-loading pages.

- Good eye for design, spacing, layout, and conversion flow.

- Comfortable working with a fast-moving startup.

- Clear communication and ability to provide updates.



Nice to Have: 

- Experience with Figma to Webflow.

- Experience building websites for AI products, SaaS products, creative tools, CRM tools, or business apps.

- Understanding of conversion-focused landing pages.

- Basic understanding of copy hierarchy and page flow.

- Experience with Webflow animations and interactions.

- Experience setting up scalable website structures for companies with multiple products or modules.



What We Are Not Looking For:

- We are not looking for someone who only installs templates.

- We are not looking for someone who needs every detail handed to them.

- We are not looking for someone who only builds pages without thinking about mobile, SEO, speed, and conversion.

- We need someone who can think through the website, build cleanly, and help us create something that feels premium and scalable.



How to Apply

Please send the following:

- Your Webflow portfolio

- 3 Webflow websites you are most proud of

- Your experience with Webflow SEO

- Your experience with Figma to Webflow

- Examples of SaaS, AI, startup, or software websites you have built

YOU'RE A FIT IF:

nt, (3) a draft episode description and YouTube metadata, and (4) one paragraph on what you would improve about our current podcast workflow.

title: Social Media Account Manager — B2B SaaS Startup (20hr/wk, Contract)
description:
**About the Company**



Yogoo (yogoo.ai) is an early-stage B2B SaaS company building tools that help software companies track and improve their visibility in AI search results — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews. We're pre-revenue, founder-led, and headquartered in NYC. Our product is live, our first paying customers are imminent, and we need someone to take social execution off the founder's plate.



We're active on X 
 Reddit, LinkedIn, and YouTube.



**What You'll Do**



- **Daily engagement queue across X, Reddit, and LinkedIn.** Each morning our system surfaces 6–10 conversations across these platforms worth replying to. You'll read the parent posts, draft replies in our voice, and ship them.

- **X account 
 is small (sub-500 followers). Your job is to grow it through consistent, high-quality engagement — not buying followers, not engagement-bait, not auto-DMs. Real conversation. Format: single-tweet posts with source screenshots + follow-up reply. No multi-tweet threads while under 500 followers.

- **Reddit comments.** Participate in subs like r/SEO, r/SaaS, r/sideproject. Comments must survive moderator scrutiny — no shouty marketing, no link-stuffing, no bold formatting, prose only.

- **LinkedIn posting + commenting.** Founder-account engagement and the company page. 2–3 original posts per week + daily commenting on others' posts. Text-first format; no cross-posting from X verbatim.

- **YouTube community management.** Comment management on existing content — responding to thoughtful comments, flagging spam, surfacing high-signal viewer questions. Expands if/when we produce more video.

- **Weekly retro every Friday.** Short Loom or written summary: what shipped, what worked, what didn't, what you learned about our voice.

- **Product feedback.** You'll be the first person outside the founding team using our internal tools. Your honest notes on what's broken or confusing shape the product.



**Compensation & Growth**



- **$8/hr to start** (~$640/month at 20hr/wk)

- **Performance-based raises:** Hit the documented scorecard floors at week 4 ? rate increase. Continued strong performance opens further raises as the company grows. We're building toward our first paying customers now — as revenue scales, compensation scales with it.

- **30-day paid pilot** with a clear scorecard shared before day 1. Pass ? ongoing contract. Don't pass ? we part on good terms with a written reference.

- **Payment:** weekly via OnlineJobs.ph EasyPay

- **1099 contractor** — you set your own hours within the 20hr/wk envelope



**Tools (provided by us):**

- X Pro (~$8/mo, paid by us) — OAuth access; you never see the password

- Native LinkedIn web — same OAuth model

- Shared password vault (1Password or Bitwarden) for Reddit; CEO holds 2FA

- Native YouTube for community management

- 2FA stays with the CEO for every account



**What We Need From You**



**Required:**

- Fluent English — you'll be writing public-facing content in our voice; the bar is high

- Real social media experience with evidence (screenshots, links, engagement numbers)

- Comfort reading B2B SaaS and tech topics — if "AI search" or "schema markup" makes your eyes glaze over, this isn't the right fit

- Reliable async work habits — we won't micromanage; we'll also notice if you go quiet for two days



**Strongly preferred:**

- Direct B2B SaaS account experience

- A Reddit account with karma and a track record of comments that didn't get removed

- Familiarity with X conventions (threading, when not to thread, engagement patterns)

- Experience with social analytics tools (Metricool, Loomly, Buffer, or similar)



**Don't apply if:**

- You're an agency or planning to subcontract

- You'd need AI to write every reply — we use AI tools heavily ourselves; the difference is judgment

- You can't commit to 20hr/wk consistently for 30 days



**How to Apply**



Send three things:



1. **One paragraph** about a social account or campaign you ran where you can prove the impact. Numbers ideal; links or screenshots better.



2. **Voice-pass test.** Read the draft post below (a real post from a past campaign, sanitized). Suggest **3 changes you'd make** and explain why in 2–3 sentences each.



   > *T1: "Plot twist: ChatGPT just expanded ads to logged-out users (per Search Engine Land).*

   > *The free-citation window we've operated in for 18 months is starting to close.*

   > *If your brand isn't already cited in AI search, you're now bidding against advertisers."*

   >

   > *T2: "Most B2B SaaS founders we talk to don't realize how much organic AI-search traffic is at stake. Our methodology shows 40%+ of buyer-research traffic flows to the top 3-5 cited brands per topic."*

   >

   > *T3: "Try it FREE: 
/audit — 60 seconds, no signup."*



3. **A link to your most-engaged X or LinkedIn post in the last 90 days.** Any topic — we're looking at how you write, not what you write about.



We read every application that includes all three. We don't read applications that skip the voice-pass test — that's the actual signal.

title: Short-Form Editor — Real Estate Channel (10+ Shorts/Week)
description:
Type of Work: Full Time



Salary: $1,000/mo base + view bonuses (realistic $1,500-$2,000/mo within 6 months)



Hours per Week: 40



Payment: Bi-weekly via Wise





ABOUT US



I'm Luke Smith. Former Army Ranger, 75th Regiment, 3rd Battalion. Former law enforcement. Licensed REALTOR with Real Broker LLC. I run a YouTube channel called Living in Middle Georgia — 13,500+ subscribers, 1M+ views — helping military families relocate to Robins Air Force Base.



We're scaling to 50,000 subscribers within 12 months. Short-form is how new people find us. You're the first in-house short-form hire. You build the look that people see first.





WHAT I NEED



I am sick and tired of generic content. Every realtor on earth has shorts now and they all look the same. Same CapCut templates. Same subtitle fonts. Same zooms. Same trending audio. Same agency output that screams "I paid someone $500/mo to post for me."



That is not us.



I need someone who can build a signature style for this brand. When someone scrolls past one of our shorts, I want them to know it's us before they see the name. The pacing, the sound, the captions, the energy — all of it should feel like Living in Middle Georgia and nobody else.



I need someone in-house who is jam up and can really make the content well. Not someone who applies templates. Someone with genuine creative taste who makes editing decisions they can explain and defend.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Edit 10+ shorts per week across YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok (60 seconds or less)

• Watch our long-form raw footage (we film 2-4 longs per week) and find the 
nts. I'm not going to timestamp them for you. You'll know what hits.

• Build and maintain a visual style that becomes instantly recognizable across every platform

• Adapt content to each platform — Shorts, Reels, and TikTok are not the same and you know why

• Coordinate with our long-form editor and SMM content creator

• First drafts within 24-48 hours

• Make some real estate 
s. Why? Because we all need to laugh sometimes.







WHAT YOU NEED



• Short-form work you personally cut — live on YouTube Shorts, Reels, or TikTok. I want to see real content with real views. Not a portfolio PDF.

• Proof that your style varies across projects. If everything in your portfolio looks the same, you're using templates, not creating. That's a fail.

• Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut Pro.

• You understand why the same clip performs differently on Shorts vs. Reels vs. TikTok.

• Reliable internet and your own editing setup.





WHO THIS IS FOR



You have opinions about editing and you can back them up. You study what's working on short-form right now — not what was trending 3 months ago. You're honest. If an edit isn't landing, you tell me. You don't ship work you know is mediocre just to hit a deadline.



This is one job for the next 5+ years. I'm building a full media team and you're a core piece of it.





WHAT I WON'T ACCEPT



• CapCut templates. If I see the same trendy font that 10,000 other accounts are using, it's an instant fail. I didn't hire in-house to look like an agency.

• Cookie-cutter subtitle animations. If I wanted that, I'd use a $30/mo tool. I'm hiring you because you're better than a tool.

• AI-generated voiceovers, fake B-roll families, or auto-captions you didn't hand-check. AI is a tool, not the editor.

• Stock "trending" music that every other Reel is using right now. Find something better.



I need the content we produce to explode the brand. The edits should look nothing like the generic stuff you get from AI platforms or agencies. That's why I'm hiring someone in-house. That's why this role exists.





PAY



• $1,000/mo base

• +$25 per short that hits 5,000 views (30-day window)

• +$100 per short that hits 50,000 views (30-day window)

• +$300 per short that hits 250,000 views (30-day window)

• Bi-weekly via Wise. Every time.



Realistically $1,500-$2,000+/mo within 6 months as volume and virality grow. The better your work, the more you earn.





HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word SCROLL in all caps. If it's not there, I delete it without reading.

2. Send 3 shorts you personally cut — live URLs on YouTube Shorts, Reels, or TikTok. Not mockups. Live content.

3. Name one short-form editor or creator outside of real estate whose work you study. What specifically would you take from their approach and apply to our channel?

4. Your editing software and years of experience.



PAID TRIAL — $50, paid whether I hire you or not.



If you make it past Step 1, I'll send you 30 minutes of raw long-form footage and a one-page brief. Cut 3 shorts from the same source:

— One that's hook-driven (stop the scroll in 1 second)

— One that's story-driven (narrative arc in under 60 seconds)

— One that's data-driven (make a stat feel urgent)

Plus 100 words per short explaining your choices. That trial is the real interview.



Async via Slack. No micromanagement. Hiring to win.



— Luke Smith, Real Broker LLC

title: Clinical Intake Specialist – US Healthcare Revenue Cycle (Outbound, BPO Experience Preferred)
description:
ABOUT APEX FLOW REVENUE CYCLE SOLUTIONS



Apex Flow Revenue Cycle Solutions LLC is a Florida-based healthcare revenue cycle management firm. We work with medical practices across Florida to identify and recover revenue lost in their billing pipeline — specifically unpaid claims sitting in the 60–90+ day aging window. Our clients are physicians, chiropractors, and clinical practices who depend on us to recover funds their current billing system is missing.



This is a legitimate, established company with active insurance, legal agreements, and a live client pipeline. We are growing and this is a long-term role.



---



THE ROLE



We need a Clinical Intake Specialist to represent Apex Flow in outbound outreach to Florida medical practices. You will be the first voice our prospects hear.



Your clinical background is what makes this role work. You will speak peer-to-peer with practice managers and billing staff using real healthcare terminology — not a generic sales script. We provide full training, a structured opening script, and daily coaching from the Managing Owner.



This is not a virtual assistant role. This is a specialized outbound clinical outreach position. If you have medical billing or BPO experience and you speak clear, accent-neutral English — this role pays well and grows with performance.



---



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Make 65 outbound calls to Florida medical practices from a pre-vetted contact list

- Deliver a structured clinical opening script to practice managers and billing administrators

- Book 30-minute Zoom audit appointments directly into our online calendar

- Log every call with full notes — contact name, outcome, next action, date

- Skip voi
 and automated systems — only log clean human conversations

- Attend a 10-minute daily debrief call with the Managing Owner



---



WHAT WE REQUIRE



MUST HAVE — these are non-negotiable:



1. Accent-neutral English. This is the single most important requirement. Our clients are Florida medical office managers. You must be clearly and immediately understood on the first sentence of every call. We conduct a voice test during the application process.



2. Clinical or medical background. RN, LPN, medical billing specialist, medical front desk, prior authorization, or healthcare administration. This background is what allows you to speak past gatekeepers naturally.



3. Outbound phone experience. Patient scheduling, insurance verification, BPO healthcare account, or any role requiring 40+ outbound calls per day. BPO experience with a US healthcare account is strongly preferred.



4. Reliable call logging discipline. Every single call documented same day. No gaps, no catch-up logging. This is how we protect the quality of our prospect list.



5. Stable internet and professional setup. Minimum 20Mbps, quiet workspace, noise-cancelling headset. We conduct a live speed test and audio check during the interview.



6. Availability Monday to Friday, 9am to 3pm Eastern Standard Time.



STRONG ADVANTAGE — not required but will increase your pay rate:



- Experience with a US medical billing BPO account

- Familiarity with terms: A/R aging, clearinghouse rejections, modifier codes, EOB, ANSI codes

- Previous experience booking appointments or warm transfers for US healthcare clients



---



COMPENSATION



Base rate: $11 to $15 USD per hour depending on experience and interview score

Weekly performance bonus: paid every Friday when daily dial target is met

Per-audit bonus: additional payment for every audit appointment booked above weekly target

Schedule: 25 to 30 hours per week to start, with opportunity to expand

This is a long-term position. We do not hire for short contracts.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Step 1: Record a 60-second voice introduction using Vocaroo (
 — free, no account needed).



In your recording, say:

(a) Your name and your medical or clinical background

(b) This sentence read naturally: "We perform zero-obligation clearinghouse checks on outstanding 60 to 90 day accounts to isolate hidden modifier rejections."



Paste your Vocaroo link in your application message. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed — no exceptions.

description:
We're not hiring a paraplanner. We're hiring the person who builds the paraplanning engine. 



Collaborus is an Australian outsourcing company built to service the financial planning sector. We're a startup — early stage, founder-led, and moving fast. 



We're now building our paraplanning division from the ground up — a managed service that delivers SOA production (ad hoc and ongoing) for Australian financial planners. Done right, this positions Collaborus as the go-to paraplanning solution provider for one of Australia's largest financial planning licensees. 



That's the opportunity. And we need one person to make it real. 



You've spent years building expertise as a paraplanner. You're good at it. But you've always wondered: "What if I could build the whole thing myself?" 



This is that chance. 



You'll join Collaborus as one of the first employees — part of the founding team in our Philippines unit. You'll report directly to the directors. You'll design the service, build the team, adopt the technology, and deliver the outcome. 



If you've always wanted to test your ability to thrive as an entrepreneur — with the backing of a real company, a real salary, and real resources — this is the role. 



It won't be easy. But it will be yours. 



???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????? 



What You'll Build 



This isn't a job description — it's a business brief. You'll be responsible for: 



- Designing the entire service model — how Collaborus delivers paraplanning to Australian FP clients, from scoping to delivery to QA 

- SOA production at scale — SOAs, ROAs, research, strategy modelling — delivered accurately, compliantly, and efficiently across managed service and ad hoc engagements 

- Building the tech stack — leveraging AI, automation, and smart workflows to deliver scoped paraplanning requests faster and sharper than traditional models 

- Hiring and leading your team — you'll have budgets to recruit paraplanners and support staff as the division grows. You build the team. You set the standard. 

- Owning service delivery end-to-end — pricing, turnaround, quality, client satisfaction. This is your unit. 

- Shaping the service proposition — working directly with Collaborus directors to refine the offering, pitch to clients, and win business 



You're not filling a seat. You're creating the seats. 



???????????????????????????????????????????????????????????? 



Who This Role Is For 



This role exists at the intersection of paraplanning expertise and entrepreneurial ambition. You need both. 



? You've spent 4+ years in the trenches of Australian financial planning — super, insurance, investments, SMSFs, retirement strategies. You know advice production inside out. 

? You've always wanted to build something — not just deliver someone else's process, but design your own. 

? You're analytical and creative — you can model a complex super strategy and design a workflow that makes the next one faster.
